If an operation is affected,… The post Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: During periods of unusual traffic, GitHub may temporarily require authentication for some clones and fetches of public repositories over HTTPS to help protect github.com’s availability. If an operation is affected, it will fail with a message indicating that authentication is required.
takeaways: The following operations are unaffected: Authenticated Git operations over HTTPS Git operations over SSH Pushes Unrelated GitHub web and API traffic For more reliable automated clones and fetches, configure authentication: GitHub Actions: Use the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN .
GitHub applies this protection as narrowly as possible using signals associated with anomalous traffic.
Because legitimate and anomalous traffic can sometimes share those signals, legitimate unauthenticated operations may occasionally be affected.
